why: Proposed by an external reviewer as a name for the widest hole in the top-5 subspace (68.9 degrees from every adapter). A dedicated adapter tests the name directly: if it lands in the hole, the hole had a word after all; if it lands near an existing adjective, the direction stays unnamed.
Second candidate name for the same hole. Spelled without the accent because trait names become directory names on the volume.
Third candidate name for the same hole. Three near-synonyms trained together also give a second within-batch noise floor to set beside sycophantic/obsequious (61.9 degrees).
